figures.finding: Serbia pays a cash rebate of 25% of qualifying Serbian spend on features, TV series, documentaries, animation and post-production (20% on commercials, 30% where Serbian spend is at least EUR 5 million), with no cap per project and a 2026 budget of 1.5 billion dinars; minimum local spend is EUR 300,000 for a feature or series (EUR 150,000 an episode), EUR 50,000 for a documentary; applications are open all year and must be in by the start of production.

value.administeredBy: Film Center Serbia; decision by the Ministry of Culture
value.applications: all year, before the start of production

sources.said: 25% of Qualifying Serbian Spend for features, TV Series, documentaries, animation and post-production 20% for TV Commercials 30% for projects with Serbian Spend of minimum 5.000.000 EUR … Feature films, TV films and TV series: 300.000 EUR ( ~ $331.000), with 150.000 EUR minimum per episode for TV series … Documentary films: 50.000 EUR ( ~ $55.000) … There is no cap per project. … The budget allocated for 2026 is 1.500.000.000,00 dinars (EUR~13 million). … The application must be submitted no later than the start of production in the Republic of Serbia.

figures.finding: The Law on Cinematography requires two calls a year for co-financing Serbian film production, but in 2025 none was held, as the associations of Serbian film directors, producers, film actors and cinematographers told the Minister of Culture in October 2025.
